title: A repository's graphyard.trial.Dockerfile runs its merge trials in its own image
description: A fixture repository commits graphyard.trial.Dockerfile (ARG GRAPHYARD_TRIAL_IMAGE, FROM it, a stub gofake copied in) and a preMerge check 'gofake verify'. With a stub docker first on PATH, the real merge trial builds the image from the base tip once and passes its check in it; a second trial reuses the built image, a candidate that edits the Dockerfile still runs the base tip's image, a repository without the file builds nothing and runs the standard image, and a build that fails is a trial-host fault, not a red head.

steps.name: real trials build the repository's image from the base tip once and run their checks in it
